bordered.zh-CN: 是否展示边框，仅在非全屏模式下有效。
bordered.en-US: Whether to show a border. Only takes effect in non-full mode.

children.zh-CN: 消息下方的自定义内容。

closeIcon.zh-CN: 替换关闭按钮内图标的 snippet；传入 `null` 则不显示关闭按钮。
closeIcon.en-US: Snippet that replaces the icon in the close button. Pass `null` to remove the button.

fullMode.en-US: Whether the banner is in full mode.

icon.zh-CN: 替换类型图标的 snippet；传入 `null` 则不显示图标。
icon.en-US: Snippet that replaces the icon of the type. Pass `null` to hide the icon.

onClose.zh-CN: 点击关闭按钮时的回调，参数为按钮的原生 click 事件；回调返回后横幅隐藏。
onClose.en-US: Called when the close button is clicked, with its native click event. The banner hides once the callback returns.

title.zh-CN: 标题，可以是字符串或 snippet。
title.en-US: Title, a string or a snippet.

type.en-US: Type: info, success, danger or warning.
